research.title: Negation Sensitivity in Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare sentiment classifiers on original reviews and minimally edited variants containing negation.
Analyzed prediction changes across negation scope and sentence length, checking whether edited examples preserved plausible wording and interpretable sentiment labels.

research.title: Confidence Calibration for Support Request Classification Across Domains
bullets: Designed evaluation protocols with supervisor guidance for support request classification, separating service domains to examine performance under vocabulary shifts.
Compared temperature scaling and uncalibrated predictions using reliability diagrams, calibration error, and manual review of confidently misclassified requests.

publications.title: Evaluating Confidence Calibration in Support Request Classification Under Domain Shift

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Question Matching
bullets: Implemented lexical retrieval and pretrained sentence embedding baselines for matching user questions to relevant answers in a shared document collection.
Compared ranking quality using reciprocal rank and recall, examining failures involving paraphrases, rare terminology, and overlapping answer content.

projects.title: Feature-Based and Neural Sequence Tagging
bullets: Implemented a conditional random field and a bidirectional recurrent tagger for named entity recognition using consistent tokenization and dataset partitions.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, then inspected boundary errors and confusion between entity categories in sentences containing unfamiliar names.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Extractive Summarization Methods
bullets: Implemented centroid-based and graph-based sentence selection for extractive summarization, applying the same length constraints and preprocessing to both methods.
Compared summaries using reference overlap and manual checks of redundancy, sentence ordering, and coverage of central document claims.
